create_DPRContextEncoder: create a DPRContextEncoder model to generate context embeddings for open domain question answering
create_DPRQuestionEncoder: create a DPRQuestionEncoder model to generate question embeddings for open domain question answering
create_DPRReader: create a DPRReader model to predict answer spans and passage relevance from questions and passages
build_DPREncoder: build a DPREncoder wrapping BertModel with optional projection layer for embedding generation
build_DPRSpanPredictor: build a DPRSpanPredictor with DPREncoder and QA heads for start, end, and relevance logits
